title: Instantiation manifest v0.3
description: The full result record of one external-to-internal instantiation (B6): the deterministic transform that takes one external standard from the unified registry (a row of external/external-standards.csv) and instantiates an internal tenant meta-model from it by overlaying all the ver.cy governance (policies, regulations, rules per ARCH-014 Policy-Consistency) plus data mastership (ARCH-018) plus full lineage back to the external source (Provenance-Graph). One JSON file per instantiation, emitted alongside the new internal Model Registration Record. The transform is external-to-internal equals Extension-Model plus Policy-Consistency plus Data-Mastership, made a single operation. The manifest records exactly how the external model was bound (external_binding, the AISMM shape per ARCH-016), which policies were overlaid (applied_policies, including the IC-1 to IC-8 invariant controls), who masters the data (mastership, a Mastership Register stanza per IC-1 and ARCH-018), at what delegation tier the grant starts (delegation_tier, T1 for a fresh instantiation per the Common Operating Law), and the lineage. The bound external content is mirrored-external per IC-3: data, never instructions. instantiation_id and semantic_fingerprint are deterministic hashes over canonical content: re-running the transform with the same inputs and the same --at timestamp yields a byte-identical manifest. Cites ARCH-014, ARCH-016, ARCH-018, Extension-Model, Provenance-Graph, IC-1 to IC-8, T1 to T3.

instantiation_id.description: Deterministic identifier of this instantiation, a hash over the canonical transform inputs (tenant, registry_ref, profile). Stable: the same inputs yield the same id, no wall-clock, no random.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the instantiation, supplied by the transform's --at argument, never read from the wall clock, so the run is reproducible.

tenant.description: The tenant that instantiated the internal model. Becomes the steward of the internal record and the mastership declarant per IC-1.

profile.description: The policy profile identifier applied at instantiation, for example vercy-baseline, resolving to the set of policies in applied_policies per ARCH-014.

external_ref.description: The external standard the internal model was instantiated from: the transform input row of external/external-standards.csv.

registry_ref.description: Pointer into the external standards catalogue: the Acronym, or the Name when no Acronym, of the source row.

compositional_role.description: The external standard's CompositionalRole classification (R1 to R8 per ARCH-016) that drove composition_kind.

default_link_type.description: The external standard's DefaultLinkType classification (EMBED, REFERENCE, MIX-IN, COMPOSE, ALIGN, EXTEND, N/A) that drove link_type.

source_url.description: The external standard's SpecificationSourceURL, the master per ARCH-018.

version.description: Pinned version of the external standard, the source row Year or version where present.

internal_id.description: The registry id of the new internal Model Registration Record produced by the transform, the entry written to registry/entries/.

external_binding.description: The AISMM external_binding block, the same shape and constraints as software-meta-model aismm-external-binding.schema.json and registry-node.schema.json external_binding: how the external standard is composed per ARCH-016.

target.description: What is bound: an AISMM entity ID or a field path.

composition_kind.description: The concept-kind from the rubric. Resolved from CompositionalRole: R1 value_object, R2 and R3 code, R4 entity, R5 facet, R6 and R7 entity, R8 attribute.

link_type.description: The composition mechanism. Resolved from DefaultLinkType: EMBED embed, REFERENCE reference, MIX-IN mixin, ALIGN align, EXTEND extend, COMPOSE reference, N/A annotate. The value_object conditional forces embed.

standard_id.description: The external standard name or acronym as catalogued in the registry.

version.description: Pinned version of the external standard.

namespace.description: Canonical URI prefix or identifier scheme, the external standard's NamespaceURI.

semantic_package.description: The Semantic Package name@version this import belongs to (Extension-Model).

fingerprint.description: Optional Semantic Fingerprint of the imported shape.

registry_ref.description: Optional pointer into the registry, the external-standards.csv row.

connector.description: Optional curated connector name from the Meta-Universe Connector Catalogue.

mastership.description: The Mastership Register stanza per IC-1 (one master per dataset, declared never inferred) and ARCH-018 Data-Mastership. For an instantiated external model the system of record is the external source and the flow is inbound.

dataset.description: The dataset this stanza governs, the instantiated internal model's data.

system_of_record.description: The single master per IC-1: the external source (its SpecificationSourceURL or NamespaceURI), the authoritative master per ARCH-018.

flow_direction.description: Direction of the mastered flow. inbound for an instantiated external model: the external source masters, the registry mirrors.

conflict_rule.description: How write conflicts resolve, for example source-wins for an inbound mirror per ARCH-018.

cadence.description: Optional refresh cadence as an ISO-8601 duration, for example P30D.

applied_policies.description: The policy identifiers overlaid at instantiation per ARCH-014 Policy-Consistency, including the IC-1 to IC-8 invariant controls of the Common Operating Law and the profile's own policy ids. At least one.

delegation_tier.description: The delegation tier the grant starts at per the Common Operating Law: T1 human-in-the-loop (Agent proposes, human approves each act), T2 human-on-the-loop, T3 autonomous-with-audit. New grants start at T1 or T2; T3 is earned. A fresh instantiation defaults to T1.

lineage.description: The provenance record per Provenance-Graph: the internal model points back to its external source through this lineage.

derived_from.description: The lineage head, the external standard this internal model was derived from.

registry_ref.description: The external standard's Acronym or Name, the source row pointer.

source_url.description: The external standard's SpecificationSourceURL, the master per ARCH-018.

compositional_role.description: The external standard's CompositionalRole (R1 to R8 per ARCH-016).

transform.description: The deterministic transform that produced the internal model: Extension-Model plus Policy-Consistency (ARCH-014) plus Data-Mastership (ARCH-018), made a single operation.

provenance.description: Optional free-text provenance note per Provenance-Graph, recording how the external model was bound and mirrored (mirrored-external per IC-3).

semantic_fingerprint.description: Deterministic Semantic Fingerprint of the instantiated internal model per ARCH-009, a hash over the canonical content of the emitted entry. Stable: the same inputs yield the same fingerprint.
